questions.prompt: Have you ever parked in the wrong place or driven ____1____ (fast) than the speed limit (限制)?
questions.analysis: 1.句意：你是否曾把车停错地方或超速驾驶？根据“than”可知空处需用比较级。故填faster。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Every year ____2____ (thousand) of drivers become “offenders”-they break the rules of the road.
questions.analysis: 2.句意：每年都有成千上万的司机成为“违规者”——他们违反交通规则。空前无具体数字，需用thousands of“数以千计的”表示泛指。故填thousands。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: But ___3____ are the punishments for this offence?
questions.analysis: 3.句意：但是这种罪行的惩罚是什么呢？根据“are the punishments for this offence?”可知是询问处罚是什么。what表示“什么”。故填what。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In most countries drivers have to pay a fine (罚款), ____4____ (usual) $100—$300.
questions.analysis: 4.句意：在大多数国家，司机必须支付罚款，通常是100到300美元。修饰动词，需用副词形式usually表示“通常”。故填usually。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: But in the USA, Australia and some ____5___ (Europe) countries offenders also get points on their driving license.
questions.analysis: 5.句意：但在美国、澳大利亚和一些欧洲国家，违规者的驾驶执照也会被扣分。修饰名词“countries”，需用形容词作定语。European“欧洲的”。故填European。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: After they get ___6___ certain number of points, they can’t drive.
questions.analysis: 6.句意：在他们得到一定数量的分数之后，他们就不能开车了。a certain number of表示“一定数量的……”。故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: So far some states in the USA ____7___ (introduce) a new way to avoid this-Traffic School.
questions.analysis: 7.句意：到目前为止，美国的一些州已经推出了一种新的方法来避免这种情况——交通学校。根据“So far”可知本句需用现在完成时(have/has done)，主语是复数，助动词用have。故填have introduced。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: They can get points on their license ___8____ they can do a course at Traffic School.
questions.analysis: 8.句意：违法者有一个选择：如果他们能在交通学校学习课程，他们可以在驾照上获得分数。分析句子可知，前句是后句是肯定条件，需用if表示“如果”。故填if。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: They cost about $100 and take from four ____9____ twelve hours.
questions.analysis: 9.句意：它们花费大约100美元，需要4到12个小时。from...to...表示“从……到……”，固定短语。故填to。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Drivers learn the rules of the road and they learn how ___10____ (be) better drivers.
questions.analysis:
10.句意：司机学习道路规则，他们学习如何成为更好的司机。how to do sth表示“如何做某事”。故填to be。

questions.analysis: 1.句意：当Reshma Kosaraju 12岁时，她的家人从芝加哥搬到了北加州。根据“When Reshma Kosaraju was 12”可知，时态是一般过去时，动词用过去式。故填moved。

questions.prompt: ____3____ her school was about 320 kilometers south of the fire, students still had to wear masks (面罩) because ____4____ the smoke.
questions.analysis: 3.句意：虽然她的学校在火灾以南约320公里处，但由于浓烟弥漫，学生们仍然不得不戴上口罩。分析“...her school was about 320 kilometers south of the fire, students still had to wear masks...”可知，前后构成让步关系，用though/although引导让步状语从句。故填Though/Although。

questions.prompt: ____3____ her school was about 320 kilometers south of the fire, students still had to wear masks (面罩) because ____4____ the smoke.
questions.analysis: 4.句意：虽然她的学校在火灾以南约320公里处，但由于浓烟弥漫，学生们仍然不得不戴上口罩。根据“students still had to wear masks (面罩) because...the smoke”可知，由于浓烟弥漫，学生们仍然不得不戴上口罩，because of“因为”符合语境，故填of。

questions.prompt: “It is an unusual experience for me, because I have never ____5____ (real) experienced this problem,” she said.
questions.analysis: 5.句意：对我来说是一次不寻常的经历，因为我从来没有真正经历过这个问题。此处在句中修饰动词，用副词形式，故填really。

source.sourceSection: （2023·浙江绍兴中考）阅读下面短文，在空白处填入一个适当的词，或填入括号中所给单词的正确形式。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: During the visit, my attention was drawn away from the plants, bridges and stones, towards ____1____ walls of the gardens.
questions.analysis: 1.句意：在参观期间，我的注意力从植物、桥梁和石头上转移到了花园的墙壁上。根据“walls of the gardens.”可知此处是特指花园的墙壁，应用定冠词the，故填the。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Mostly white, some parts of the walls are losing small ____2___ (piece) of their covering.
questions.analysis: 2.句意：大部分墙壁是白色的，有些部分正在失去小块的覆盖物。piece“块”，可数名词，此处应用复数表示泛指，故填pieces。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: This creates space in which light and plants can be ____3___ (see).
questions.analysis: 3.句意：这创造了可以看到光线和植物的空间。see是动词，根据“can be”可知是含有情态动词can的被动语态can be done，故填seen。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: I kept ____4____ (imagine) how many shadows (影) could be collected by them to dance with the light.
questions.analysis: 4.句意：我一直在想象，它们能收集多少影子，与光共舞。keep doing sth“一直做某事”，为固定短语，故填imagining。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: This fantastic moment was so lively ____5____ I came back to explore it with my camera.
questions.analysis: 5.句意：这个奇妙的时刻是如此的生动，以至于我带着相机回来探索它。根据“so lively...I came back to explore it with my camera.”可知此处是so...that“如此……以至于……”引导的结果状语从句，故填that。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Working ____6____ (free) with these walls and their marks, I began to feel like collecting all the stories that were painted there.
questions.analysis: 6.句意：在这些墙壁和它们的标记上自由地工作，我开始想收集所有画在那里的故事。free是形容词，此处修饰动词应用副词freely，故填freely。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Weather and time have turned these ____7____ (amaze) white walls into Chinese landscape paintings.
questions.analysis: 7.句意：天气和时间把这些令人惊叹的白墙变成了中国山水画。空后是名词，所以此处应用形容词amazing“令人惊奇的”修饰物，故填amazing。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: I ___8___ (take) the photos during the month of June, just after the rain.
questions.analysis: 8.句意：这些照片是我在六月雨后拍摄的。take是动词，根据语境和后句可知，本句是一般过去时，动词用过去式，故填took。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The air was full of small drops of water, showing the light and the color ____9____ the things around.
questions.analysis: 9.句意：空气中充满了小水滴，显示出周围事物的光和颜色。根据“the color...the things around”可知是指周围事物的颜色，应用of所有格，表示“……的”，故填of。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: As color was born out of a dance between light and a body, when photographing in color I found ___10___ (I) enjoying a moment of this dance.
questions.analysis: 10.句意：因为色彩是光与身体之间的舞蹈而产生的，所以当我拍摄彩色照片时，我发现自己在享受这种舞蹈的时刻。根据“I found...enjoying a moment of this dance.”可知主语是I，所以宾语应该用反身代词myself，故填myself。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: However, mulberry trees (桑树) and fruit trees were ___3___ (popular) of all.
questions.analysis: 3.句意：然而，桑树和果树是最受欢迎的。根据“of all”可知此处用最高级most popular，最高级前加定冠词the。故填the most popular。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Gradually, a forest of apricot trees grew on ___7___ hill.
questions.analysis: 7.句意：渐渐地，山上长出了一片杏树林。此处特指前文提到的山，用定冠词the。故填the。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: So, ____10____ Tree Planting Day next year, do you want to plant a tree with your wishes on it?
questions.analysis: 10.句意：在明年的植树节，你想种一棵带着你愿望的树吗？空后是具体某一天，用介词on。故填on。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It falls ____1____ September 1st every year.
questions.analysis: 1.句意：它是在每年的9月1日。“September 1st”是具体的时间，用介词on，故填on。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: He encouraged people ____2____ (take) a break from today’s social media (媒体) and write a letter to someone by hand.
questions.analysis: 2.句意：他鼓励人们从今天的社交媒体中休息一下，手写一封信给别人。encourage sb to do sth“鼓励某人做某事”，故填to take。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: A parent or best friend would also love to receive ____3___ (you) letter.
questions.analysis: 3.句意：父母或最好的朋友也会很乐意收到你的信。此处在句中作定语修饰letter，用形容词性物主代词your。故填your。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: ____4____ (general) speaking, a letter includes these parts.
questions.analysis: 4.句意：一般来说，一封信包括这些部分。generally “一般来说”，句首需大写首字母。故填Generally。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: End it by ____5____ (sign) it.
questions.analysis: 5.句意：通过签名来结束它。by是介词，其后加动名词作宾语。故填signing。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It’s ___6____ good way to show people that you have been thinking of them.
questions.analysis: 6.句意：这是一个很好的方式来告诉人们你一直在想着他们。此处泛指一个方法，good首字母发辅音音素，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It makes ____7____ (enjoy) memories (回忆).
questions.analysis: 7.句意：它带来愉快的回忆。此处作定语修饰memories，用形容词形式。故填enjoyable。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Some people save ___8____ (letter) and look at them over the years.
questions.analysis: 8.句意：有些人把信件保存起来，多年来一直看。根据“them”可知，此处应使用名词复数形式。故填letters。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: A recent study shows that letter writing ___9____ (make) the writer happy, too.
questions.analysis: 9.句意：最近的一项研究表明，写信也会让写信人感到快乐。本句时态是一般现在时，主语是“letter writing”，动词用三单。故填makes。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: So, get some paper ____10____ pick up a pen.
questions.analysis: 10.句意：所以，拿起纸和笔。分析“get some paper...pick up a pen”可知，前后构成并列关系，用and连接。故填and。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Wushu, also known as martial arts, is one of the earliest ___36___ (sport) in China.
questions.analysis: 36.句意：武术又称武术，是中国最早的体育项目之一。one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数“最……之一”。故填sports。

questions.prompt: What’s more, Wushu is an outstanding example of ___37___ (tradition) Chinese culture.
questions.analysis: 37.句意：更重要 的是，武术是中国传统文化的杰出代表。此处修饰名词短语Chinese culture，用形容词traditional“传统的”，作定语。故填traditional。

source.sourceSection: （2024·深圳一模）阅读下面短文，在空白处填入一个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: I paid for it with ____49____ money I made and it felt very different.

questions.prompt: This experience teaches me what it means to work hard and I ____50____ (learn) that you must be careful with the things you have, because they take a lot of hard work.
questions.analysis: 50.句意：这段经历教会了我努力工作的意义，我学会了你必须小心对待你拥有的东西，因为它们需要付出很多努力。根据“This experience teaches me what it means to work hard and I...that you must be careful with the things you have”可知，本句可用现在完成时强调动作已经发生，或用一般现在时强调现在，主语是I，助动词是have，动词用原形。故填have learned/have learnt/learn。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It appeared in the Yellow River during the rule of Emperor Yao, and the people ___22___ (force) to give up their villages and go to live in trees or mountains.
questions.analysis: 22. 句意：它出现在黄帝统治时期的黄河中，人们被迫放弃村庄，去树上或山上生活。主语the people与动词force之间是被动关系，因此用被动语态；这里讲述过去发生的事情，因此用一般过去时的被动语态，主语the people是复数，因此be动词用were，force的过去分词为forced。故填were forced。

questions.prompt: Receiving the order, Gun led his team to build dikes (堤坝) to keep back the water ___24___ failed.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: For thirteen years, he put ___26___ (he) to his work.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Drawing a lesson from his father’s failure, he used methods of channeling and dredging (挖道和疏浚) and controlled the great flood ___27___ (success).

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: He did so much ___28___ the people that they called him “Yu the Great” and Emperor Shun chose him as the next emperor.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: He was such ___29___ wise, strong-minded and great person that he is worth _____30_____ (learn) from.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: He was such ___29___ wise, strong-minded and great person that he is worth _____30_____ (learn) from.

questions.prompt: In Chinese, the word for “willow” is pronounced the same ____32____ the word for “stay.

questions.prompt: Now blind box toys have become very popular since they ____43____ (introduce) to China.
questions.analysis: 43. 句意：现在盲盒玩具自从传入中国后变得非常受欢迎。本句主语“they”和谓语“introduce”是被动关系，本句是现在时，因此这里是一般现在时的被动语态，主语是复数，因此be动词是were，introduce的过去分词是introduced，故填were introduced。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: So the buyers don’t know what is in the boxes until they open ____44____ (they).

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The most popular toys in the blind boxes are cute characters ____45____ come from pop movies, comics and cartoons.
questions.analysis: 45. 句意：盲盒中最受欢迎的玩具是来自流行电影、漫画和卡通的可爱角色。根据“The most popular toys in the blind boxes are cute characters...come from pop movies, comics and cartoons.”可知，本句是定语从句，先行词“cute characters”是物，且从句缺少主语，因此填关系代词which或that，故填which/that。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: There ____46____ (be) a few special ones in many common boxes.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: My wish is ____47____ (open) another box!

questions.prompt: It is the first Chinese Hanfu Day, ____53____ lasted until May 8.

questions.prompt: In ancient China, this day was also known ____54____ Shanghai Festival.

questions.prompt: Its purpose is to encourage young Chinese to take ____55____ (proud) in traditional clothing, as well as Chinese culture.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It has a history of about 3,000 years and it ____56____ (change) greatly so far.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: ____57____ we don’t know the number of people who wear Hanfu today, we can find Hanfu clubs in almost every city.

questions.prompt: China is becoming ____58____ leading country in the world, and the Chinese public feels ____59____ (confident) about its traditional culture than ever before.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When I got a bit older, my aunt brought back her boyfriend and my grandma cheerfully ___62___ (add) another seat to the round table.

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题17 语法填空-2024年中考英语真题题源解密（全国通用）

questions.analysis: 10.句意：今天我们养成了刷牙的好习惯。根据“Today we have a good...of brushing teeth.”可知刷牙是好习惯。have a good habit of“有一个……好习惯”。故填habit。

questions.prompt: In fact, plants are not always ___2___.

questions.prompt: However, the pitch (音高) is too high for people ___4___,” said Lilach Hadany, a professor from Tel Aviv University.
questions.analysis: 4.句意：然而，音调太高，人们听不到。根据“the pitch (音高) is too high for people”及备选词可知，人们听不到这些声音，hear“听”，too…to“太……而不能”，故填to hear。

questions.prompt: The researchers used microphones to record some tomato plants and found that stressed plants send out ___5___ sounds than unstressed plants.
questions.analysis: 5.句意：研究人员用麦克风记录了一些番茄植株，发现受到压力的植株比没有受到压力的植株发出更多的声音。根据than可知，此处用比较级，根据“When tomatoes are not stressed at all, they are very quiet”可知，当番茄完全没有承受压力时，它们会非常安静，也就是说受到压力的植株比没有受到压力的植株发出更多的声音，many的比较级more“更多的”符合，故填more。

questions.prompt: They also trained a machine in ___6___ the differences between thirsty plants and cut plants.
questions.analysis: 6.句意：他们还训练了一台机器来区分干渴的植物和被切割的植物。根据“the differences between thirsty plants and cut plants”及备选词可知，讲述干渴的植物和切割的植物之间的区别，tell“讲述”，in是介词，后接动名词，故填telling。

questions.analysis: 7.句意：研究结果表明，当压力的原因发生变化时，它们产生的效果会有所不同。根据“when the causes of stress change, they shout”以及备选词可知，压力原因发生变化，产生的效果也不同，副词differently修饰动词shout，故填differently。

questions.prompt: For example, people will make sure whether corn is getting enough water or where water is needed most without much ___10___.
questions.analysis: 10.句意：例如，人们可以毫不费力地确定玉米是否有足够的水或者哪里最需要水。根据前文描述可知，这种记录可以给人们带来好处，所以此处指毫不费力地确定玉米是否有足够的水或者哪里最需要水，without difficulty“毫不费力地”，故填difficulty。

questions.prompt: Three years ago, I paid a visit to my ____(uncle) home in Sydney.

questions.prompt: Bye added that summer camps are important to both kids and ____(parent).
questions.analysis: 考查名词的数。由关键词kids可知,此处应用名词复数形式。

questions.prompt: At her first concert, she played in a band with many ____(adult).
questions.analysis: 考查名词的数。由关键词many可知设空处用名词复数形式。

questions.prompt: People used it for food, clothing, transportation, houses and musical ____(instrument).
questions.analysis: 本题考查名词的数。设空处提示词是可数名词,这里指乐器这一类事物,是总称,因此用其复数形式。

questions.prompt: Every year, it attracts millions of ____(visitor) from home and abroad.
questions.analysis: 本题考查名词的数。设空处提示词是可数名词,设空处前有millions of,因此使用其复数形式。

questions.prompt: Jack and Mike are two plants. They are neighbors. One day, Jack’s ____(leaf) touch Mike.
questions.analysis: leaf是可数名词,根据touch可知应用leaf的复数形式,故填leaves。

questions.prompt: He saw that the bus driver was no longer sitting in the ____(driver) seat—she had passed out and collapsed(晕倒) on the bus stairs.
questions.analysis: 本题考查名词所有格。设空处提示词driver和其后单词seat之间为所属关系,因此答案是driver’s。

questions.prompt: The baby girl learned how to dress ____ (her) at the age of 3.
questions.analysis: 考查反身代词。dress oneself表示“某人给自己穿衣服”。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: He took out two large books and opened one of ____(they).
questions.analysis: 本题考查代词。设空处指代名词books,用人称代词宾格,故填them。

source.sourceSection: 第12节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: People who sit with laptops on ____(they) legs for hours and hours have noticed they get dark marks on their legs.
questions.analysis: 本题考查代词。设空处修饰名词legs,用形容词性物主代词,故填their。归纳总结：notice n.通知;v.注意到

questions.prompt: “You’ve got my phone and I’ve got ____(you),” I said. “We exchanged our phones by accident!”
questions.analysis: 本题考查代词。根据“We exchanged our phones by accident!”可知“我们”误拿了彼此的手机,设空处应用名词性物主代词,you的名词性物主代词是yours,故填yours。归纳总结：by accident偶然;by mistake错误地

questions.prompt: I want to show ____(I) respect for the three astronauts, especially Wang, the first woman Chinese astronaut to enter the space station.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。设空处修饰名词respect,应用形容词性物主代词,故填my。

questions.prompt: And in April 2021, the city decided to start ____activity asking owners to pick up waste of their pets.
questions.analysis: 本题考查冠词。此处泛指“一项活动”,activity以元音音素开头,设空处用不定冠词an。故填an。

questions.prompt: Then how can we find happiness? I asked Sally such ____question.
questions.analysis: 本题考查冠词。设空后的question是可数名词单数,此处为“such+不定冠词+可数名词单数”结构,question以辅音音素开头,因此使用a。故填a。

source.sourceSection: 第17节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Once we tried to burn chemicals, ____chemicals produced many colors of flames (火焰),including bright orange and dark green.
questions.analysis: 本题考查冠词。根据burn chemicals可知,此处第二次提到chemicals,因此用定冠词the。故填the。

source.sourceSection: 第18节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: And bamboo played ____important role in it.
questions.analysis: 本题考查冠词。play a role起作用。important以元音音素开头,因此使用不定冠词an。

questions.prompt: Wuhan is one of ____largest and most beautiful cities in China.
questions.analysis: 本题考查冠词。设空处后为形容词最高级,因此设空处使用定冠词the。

questions.prompt: Soon, another bus driver and ____ambulance(救护车) arrived to help.
questions.analysis: 本题考查冠词。设空处修饰其后的可数名词ambulance,ambulance为单数形式,第一次出现且以元音音素开头,因此使用不定冠词an。

source.sourceSection: 第21节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.analysis: 本题考查数词。millions of意为“数百万的……”。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: My pen friend is Allison. She is a lovely Australian girl ____big blue eyes.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。此处表示“有一双蓝色的大眼睛”,with“有;具有”符合语境。

source.sourceSection: 第23节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: A few months ago, my friend Henry and I planned to have a pizza at a restaurant in town. My dad kindly took us there ____his car.
questions.analysis: 本题考查介词。in one’s car坐车,开车,故填in。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: They mainly eat bamboos, and they also eat other food ____milk and meat.
questions.analysis: 本题考查介词。根据“milk and meat”可知,牛奶和肉属于前文提到的“other food”,所以此处使用like,意为“像,比如”,表示举例说明。故填like。

source.sourceSection: 第25节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: The city has tried to deal ____the problem.
questions.analysis: 本题考查介词。deal with处理。故填with。

source.sourceSection: 第26节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: One evening he was walking ____the open road outside the village. His eyes were fixed on the stars.
questions.analysis: 本题考查介词。根据“the open road outside the village”可知,此处描述的是“沿着宽阔的道路”或“在宽阔的道路上”,因此应该用介词along或on。故填along/on。

source.sourceSection: 第27节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Jack is the shortest a____ all students in his class.
questions.analysis: 本题考查介词。根据“all students in his class”可知,此处是指在所有的学生之间,among在……之间(三个及以上之间),故填 among。

source.sourceSection: 第28节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: She took the ant out of her ear and was ____(final) able to get some peace.
questions.analysis: 本题考查副词。设空处修饰was able to,因此使用副词形式。故填finally。

source.sourceSection: 第29节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: So, keep the balance of your present life while you work for a ____(happy) and brighter tomorrow.
questions.analysis: 本题考查形容词的比较级。根据空后的and brighter可知,设空处应该用比较级,happy的比较级为happier。故填happier。

source.sourceSection: 第30节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Unluckily, the phone became locked. I couldn’t use it. I was a little ____(worry).
questions.analysis: 本题考查形容词。由was可知设空处应用形容词作表语,worry担心,担忧,名词或动词,其形容词是worried“担心的,焦虑的”,故填worried。

source.sourceSection: 第31节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Pandas like climbing trees—the higher, the ____(good).
questions.analysis: 考查形容词的比较级。根据the higher可知,此处考查“the+比较级,the+比较级”,good的比较级为better。故填better。

source.sourceSection: 第32节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Wearing pants and putting a laptop’s case under the laptop is ____(usual) enough to protect one’s skin from the computer’s heat.
questions.analysis: 本题考查副词。设空处修饰形容词enough,因此是副词形式,故填usually。

source.sourceSection: 第33节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Giving away your time for free is ____(difference) and it shows real care to the charity.
questions.analysis: 句意:免费奉献你的时间是不同的,它显示了对慈善机构的真正关怀。本题考查形容词。根据设空处前的“is”可知,设空处应该填的是形容词,different“不同的”作表语,故填different。

source.sourceSection: 第34节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: During the Han Dynasty, the people in Sichuan ____(success) dug a 100⁃metre⁃deep well(井) with thick bamboo ropes.
questions.analysis: 本题考查副词。设空处修饰谓语动词dug,因此使用副词形式。

source.sourceSection: 第35节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: I feel so ____(excite) by this. The city is famous for lots of delicious snacks.
questions.analysis: 本题考查形容词。设空处的主语是I,描述人的感受,因此使用⁃ed结尾的形容词。

source.sourceSection: 第36节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Of all the wooden toys, his grandson thinks the walking Peppa Pig is ____(cute).
questions.analysis: 本题考查形容词最高级。根据Of all the wooden toys可知,设空处使用最高级形式,注意其前加定冠词the。

source.sourceSection: 第37节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: In quiet carriages, on⁃board videos will be played ____(silence) and announcements will be made at the lower volume (音量).
questions.analysis: 本题考查副词。设空处修饰谓语动词will be played, 因此使用副词形式。

source.sourceSection: 第38节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: I chose Spanish(西班牙语) and did a one⁃month course at a language school and ____(find) that some Spanish words are very similar to English ones.
questions.analysis: 考查动词的时态。主句的主语为I,设空处与chose、did并列作主句的谓语,因此设空处的时态是一般过去时,答案为found。

source.sourceSection: 第39节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Next year, they ____(make) a CD of their songs and start a charity.
questions.analysis: 本题考查动词的时态。根据 Next year 可知是明年的计划,所以使用一般将来时。主语是they,故答案是will make/are going to make。

source.sourceSection: 第40节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: But surely, people believe, his dream ____(come) true in the near future.
questions.analysis: 本题考查动词的时态。根据时间状语in the near future可知用一般将来时。

source.sourceSection: 第41节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: And then it just ____(grow) and makes the world a better place.
questions.analysis: 本题考查动词的时态。此处主语it为第三人称单数。由于and连接的前后两个动词为并列关系,根据makes可知时态为一般现在时,故填grows。

source.sourceSection: 第42节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: While we ____(eat)breakfast, Claudio went upstairs to collect his things.
questions.analysis: 本题考查动词的时态。关键词While提示了设空处为进行时态,由went可知应该使用过去进行时。

source.sourceSection: 第43节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: I ____(consider)whether to tell her the truth for a long time.
questions.analysis: 本题考查动词的时态。根据设空句中的关键信息for a long time可以判断此处为现在完成时。故填have considered。

source.sourceSection: 第44节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: We saw many koalas and were happy to see that they ____(protect) well in the forest.
questions.analysis: 考查被动语态。由语境可知,they与protect是被动关系,又由前面主句中saw和were可知,这里用一般过去时的被动语态。从句主语是they,助动词用were。

source.sourceSection: 第45节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: They live in huts—little “houses”. These houses ____(make)of wood and grass.
questions.analysis: 本题考查时态和语态。主语为复数;根据live可知,时态为一般现在时。be made of 由……制成,故填are made。

source.sourceSection: 第46节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: It ____(invent) for people to see each other while talking online.
questions.analysis: 本题考查被动语态。分析句子结构可知,主语It和动词invent之间为被动关系,即它被发明来供人们视频通话。

source.sourceSection: 第47节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Most programs will not ____(allow)to have more than 30 kids.
questions.analysis: 句意:大多数项目不被允许超过30个孩子。本题考查被动语态。主语Most programs与allow之间是被动关系,因此设空处应用被动语态。

source.sourceSection: 第48节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: “Why? Your bright sunny smile ____(love) by everybody, not how many hairs you have!”Miss Beautiful smiled.
questions.analysis: 本题考查被动语态。由空后的by可知,主语smile与love之间是被动关系,且根据语境可知设空处用一般现在时的被动语态。

source.sourceSection: 第49节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: I’ve found a friendly guide here and yesterday I ____(show) around the city.
questions.analysis: 句意:我在这儿找到了一个很友好的导游,昨天他带我参观了这座城市。本题考查一般过去时的被动语态。show sb. around领某人参观。

source.sourceSection: 第50节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: For example, it mentioned that the zipper was ____(invent)by Whitcomb Judson in 1893.
questions.analysis: 句意:例如,它提到了拉链是1893年由Whitcomb Judson发明的。设空处的提示词invent与其主语the zipper是被动关系,因此使用被动语态。

source.sourceSection: 第51节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: First of all, I think more bike lanes should ____(build).
questions.analysis: 句意:首先,我认为应该建设更多的自行车专用道。本题考查含有情态动词的被动语态。设空处的提示词build与从句的主语bike lanes是被动关系,且设空处前出现情态动词should,因此设空处填be built。

source.sourceSection: 第52节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: We all want our future ____(be) good, but time doesn’t stop for anyone.
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。want...to do意为“想要……做……”,此处用动词不定式作宾补。故填to be。

source.sourceSection: 第53节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: In China, most of the zoos have pandas. Now there are 1,864 pandas ____(live) in the zoo.
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。分析句子结构可知,句子有谓语,设空处使用live的现在分词living,说明现在的情况。故填living。

source.sourceSection: 第54节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Computers make people’s lives really easy. People can use their computers for working, ____(shop), or playing games.
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。由or可知,设空处与working和playing games并列作介词for的宾语,应用动名词,故填shopping。

source.sourceSection: 第55节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: The little ant made himself at home in the elephant’s ear and kept____(talk)to her!
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。keep doing sth.重复做某事,因此设空处填talking。

source.sourceSection: 第56节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: After finishing the meal at the restaurant, I decided ____(call) my dad.
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。decide to do sth.决定做某事, 故填to call。

source.sourceSection: 第57节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Generally, the figure⁃skaters (花样滑冰运动员) are considered ____(be) the ice kings.
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。固定短语be considered to be意为“被认为是……”。故填to be。

source.sourceSection: 第58节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: A month later I went to Spain. A Spanish teacher ____(call) Paula came and began the test.
questions.analysis: 考查过去分词。设空处作后置定语修饰前面的名词teacher,这里的意思是“一名被叫做Paula的西班牙语老师”,因此设空处为过去分词形式。答案为called。

source.sourceSection: 第59节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: “Good for you,” his brother said. “And ask Haley if she wants ____(go) to the skate park after you two finish the project.”
questions.analysis: 考查动词不定式。设空处提示词go 为动词,空前的wants跟动词不定式作宾语,故填to go。

source.sourceSection: 第60节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Finally, not only does hot pot taste wonderful, but it is the perfect way ____(spend) time with others.
questions.analysis: 本题考查动词不定式。分析句子和语境可知,此处应用不定式作后置定语,修饰空前的名词way,表示“花时间与他人在一起的最佳的方法”,故填to spend。

source.sourceSection: 第61节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: They plan ____(walk) around the whole Britain, singing for dinner and sleeping anywhere like fields.
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。plan to do sth.计划做某事,因此答案是to walk。

source.sourceSection: 第62节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: There are fewer plants and animals there, and it’s more difficult for people ____(live).
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。It’s+adj.+for sb. to do sth.对某人来说做某事是……的。

source.sourceSection: 第63节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: He used his $500 prize ____(collect) 619 toys for a local children’s hospital.
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。use sth. to do sth.使用某物去做某事,故填to collect。

source.sourceSection: 第64节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Actually, she hated it so she was always refusing ____(use) it.
questions.analysis: 本题考查非谓语动词。refuse to do sth.拒绝做某事,故填to use。

source.sourceSection: 第65节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: “____ interesting it is! This is simply fantastic!” he cried excitedly.
questions.analysis: 本题考查感叹句。根据“How+形容词+主语+谓语!”结构可知填How。

source.sourceSection: 第66节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Just before the lights turned dark, I saw my father rush into the hall and take the seat beside my mother. ____a pleasant surprise it was!
questions.analysis: 本题考查感叹句。根据“What+a/an+形容词+可数名词单数+主语+谓语!”可知填What。

source.sourceSection: 第67节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Like me,Allison loves singing and dancing,____ we both like travelling to different places for our holidays.
questions.analysis: 本题考查并列连词。由语境可知,设空处前后为并列关系,应用连词and连接两个分句。

source.sourceSection: 第68节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: There is less rain in the southern part than in the northern part, ____the south is drier.
questions.analysis: 本题考查连词。设空处前后为因果关系,且前为因后为果,故填so。

source.sourceSection: 第69节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: The other day, we chatted with my grandmother ____mentioned video calling over the Internet.
questions.analysis: 本题考查连词。前后动词形式一致且意义上为并列关系,故填and。

source.sourceSection: 第70节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Do you want to know ____our friendship started?By travelling!
questions.analysis: 本题考查连接副词。下句有表示方式的“By travelling!”,因此用how引导宾语从句。

source.sourceSection: 第71节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: I wondered ____was wrong with our phones.
questions.analysis: 本题考查宾语从句的引导词。分析句子结构可知,设空处引导宾语从句,结合语境可知,此处表示“我们的手机怎么了”,“what is/was wrong with...”表示“……怎么了”,故填what。

source.sourceSection: 第72节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Lance was so excited ____he got everything ready when Nathan got home.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。分析空前的so excited及空后的he got everything ready可知,本句为so...that...句式,意为“如此……以至于……”。故填that。

source.sourceSection: 第73节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: There are no hospitals. ____they are ill, people have to get medicine from plants.
questions.analysis: 本题考查连词。由语境可知,此处指当/如果他们生病了,他们不得不从植物中获取药物。故用When引导时间状语从句或If引导条件状语从句。

source.sourceSection: 第74节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: She can put it anywhere in the house ____it is small and doesn’t take up much room.
questions.analysis: 本题考查连词。 根据前后文的意思可知,前后文存在因果关系,前为果,后为因,故填because/as。

source.sourceSection: 第75节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: It is so beautiful ____it attracts 100,000 people every week.
questions.analysis: 考查结果状语从句。so...that...意为“如此……以至于……”。

source.sourceSection: 第77节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: The professor smiled and said, “Please describe ____you see in the test paper.”
questions.analysis: 句意:教授笑着说:“请描述一下你在试卷上看到的东西。”考查宾语从句。设空处引导宾语从句,且在从句中作see的宾语。

source.sourceSection: 第78节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: He wanted to help his mother ____she could not always get enough money to buy food for their family.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。设空前后是因果关系,后面是原因,因此答案为because/as。

source.sourceSection: 第79节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: Inside the case, there’s a number showing ____gave the book and when he gave the book.
questions.analysis: 本题考查宾语从句。设空处在宾语从句中作主语,指人。

source.sourceSection: 第80节 专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题3.单句语法填空100题冲刺卷

questions.prompt: It was made of bread and candy, and the ___1___ (window) were made of sugar.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：它是用面包和糖果做的，窗户是用糖做的。window“窗户”，是名词，结合were可知，名词用复数，故填windows。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: The children ___2___ (sudden) ran to the house and started to eat it.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：孩子们突然跑到房子里，开始吃它。sudden“突然的”，形容词，此处修饰动词ran，应用副词，故填suddenly。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: As they ate, a ___3___ (woman) voice could be heard from inside the house saying, “Who’s that, eating at my home?
questions.analysis: 3．句意：当他们吃饭的时候，一个女人的声音从屋子里传来：“谁呀，在我家吃东西？”woman是名词，空后是名词voice，所以应用woman的所有格形式woman’s修饰，故填woman’s。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” The children dropped what they ___4___ (eat), and were about to run away, but then a very old woman appeared at the door.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：孩子们扔掉了正在吃的东西，正要逃跑，这时一位老妇人出现在门口。eat“吃”，动词，根据语境可知，孩子把当时正在吃的东西扔掉，应用过去进行时，they作主语，be动词用were，故填were eating。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” The woman seemed so kind ___5___ the children lost all feeling of danger, and went straight to her, and let her take their hands and lead them into her room.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：这个女人看起来很善良，孩子们完全没有危险的感觉，他们径直走到她身边，让她牵着他们的手，把他们带到她的房间里。此处是so...that“如此……以至于”引导的结果状语从句，故填that。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They ___6___ (give) all kinds of delicious food and drink, and they were told that they could stay as long as they wanted, for the woman had another room ___6___ two clean beds.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：他们得到了各种美味的食物和饮料，并被告知他们可以想住多久就住多久，因为那个女人有另一个房间，里面有两张干净的床。give“给”，和主语they之间是被动关系，结合后句可知，应用一般过去时的被动语态。they作主语，be动词用were。故填were given。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They ___7___ (give) all kinds of delicious food and drink, and they were told that they could stay as long as they wanted, for the woman had another room ___7___ two clean beds.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：他们得到了各种美味的食物和饮料，并被告知他们可以想住多久就住多久，因为那个女人有另一个房间，里面有两张干净的床。根据“another room...two clean beds.”可知，是指房间有两张干净的床，应用介词with表示“带有”。故填with。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Her house was made of bread and candy, because children liked such things, and so it would be easier for the witch ___8___ (get) them to stay.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：她的房子是用面包和糖果做成的，因为孩子们喜欢这样的东西，所以女巫更容易让他们留下来。此处是it作形式主语，动词不定式作真正主语的结构，故填to get。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: She did not eat them right away, for often the children were very thin, and the witch wished to make them ___9___ (fat) than before, by giving them a lot of food.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：她没有马上吃掉它们，因为孩子们通常都很瘦，女巫希望给他们很多食物，让他们比以前更胖。根据“than”可知，应用形容词比较级，故填fatter。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: And so, the next morning, she ___10___ (go) into the room where the children were sleeping.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：于是，第二天早上，她走进孩子们睡觉的房间。根据前后语境可知，时态是一般过去时，动词用过去式，故填went。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Sometimes people throw away water ___1___ (bottle) or other plastic.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：有时人们会扔掉水瓶或其他塑料制品。此处表示复数含义，使用名词复数形式，故填bottles。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: People may not know that wind ___2___ rain can move garbage from land to sea.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：人们可能不知道，风和雨可以把垃圾从陆地带到海洋。wind和rain构成并列关系，用and连接，故填and。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: It can remain in the oceans ___3___ hundreds of years.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：它可以在海洋中存留数百年。“hundreds of years”是时间段，此处表示持续多长时间，故填for。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Plastic pieces are very ___4___ (danger) to sea animals.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：塑料碎片对海洋动物非常危险。此处在句中作表语，用形容词形式，故填dangerous。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: One group, Washed Ashore, came up with a new idea ___5___ (tell) people about the problems in the oceans.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：一个名为“冲上岸”的组织提出了一个新想法，向人们讲述海洋中的问题。此处在句中表示目的，用动词不定式形式，故填to tell。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: First, they take the garbage from ___6___ beach.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：首先，他们从海滩上捡垃圾。此处泛指一个海滩，beach首字母发辅音音素，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Then, they clean and sort it. ___7___
questions.analysis: 7．句意：最后，他们用塑料片制作出巨大的艺术品。此处在句中修饰整个句子，用副词finally，句首需大写首字母。故填Finally。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Washed Ashore has ___8___ (create) more than seventy of these works of art.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：“冲上岸”已经创作了70多件这样的艺术作品。时态是现在完成时，动词用过去分词形式，故填created。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Some of ___9___ (they) are now traveling in a show all over the world.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：他们中的一些人现在正在世界各地进行展览。介词后用宾格作宾语，故填them。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They think the plastic ___10___ (be) food, eat it, and get very sick or even die.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：他们认为塑料是食物，吃了它，就会生病甚至死亡。本句时态是一般现在时，主语是不可数名词，故填is。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: I wanted ___1___ （travel）around Africa with my backpack.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：我想背着背包环游非洲。want to do sth“想要做某事”，为固定短语，故填to travel。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: So I left my hometown with confidence （信心）and arrived ___2___ Cape Town, not really sure what to do next.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：于是我满怀信心地离开了家乡，来到了开普敦，不知道下一步该做什么。arrive in“到达”，是固定短语，后加大地点，故填in。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: So I left my hometown with confidence （信心）and arrived 2 Cape Town, not really sure what to do next. ___3___
questions.analysis: 3．句意：幸运的是，在我的旅行开始之前，我遇到了一位善良的尼日利亚老人。lucky是形容词，此处是修饰整个句子，应用副词形式。故填Luckily。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He gave me the ___4___ （good） travel advice I had ever received:
questions.analysis: 4．句意：他给了我最好的旅行建议：“像一个学生一样环游世界。”good“好的”，根据“I had ever received”可知此处应用形容词最高级，故填best。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” The advice sounded simple, but ___5___ really changed my idea about traveling.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：这个建议听起来很简单，但它确实改变了我对旅行的看法。此空代指advice，是不可数名词，应用it，故填it。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He helped me realize that travel is about ___6___ （learn）cultures.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：他帮助我认识到旅行是学习文化的。about是介词，后加动名词作宾语，故填learning。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: It’s far too easy to go into ___7___ new country and believe your ways are better.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：进入一个新的国家，很容易就会相信自己的方式更好。此处泛指一个新国家，应用不定冠词，new以辅音音素开头，应用a，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: “But if you study, ask questions, ___8___ try to learn from the locals, you will have far richer experience,” he promised.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：“但如果你学习，多问问题，并试着向当地人学习，你会有更丰富的经验，”他保证说。前后是并列关系，应用and连接，故填and。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: After seven ___9___ （month）of full backpacking in Africa from Cape Town to Cairo, I realized having a student-like mind helped me learn a lot, which ___9___ （satisfy）me more than any other trip that ever did to me.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：在非洲从开普敦到开罗的七个月的背包旅行中，我意识到有一颗学生的心帮助我学到了很多东西，这比我以往任何一次旅行都更让我满意。month是可数名词，位于seven后，应用复数名词，故填months。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: After seven ___10___ （month）of full backpacking in Africa from Cape Town to Cairo, I realized having a student-like mind helped me learn a lot, which ___10___ （satisfy）me more than any other trip that ever did to me.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：在非洲从开普敦到开罗的七个月的背包旅行中，我意识到有一颗学生的心帮助我学到了很多东西，这比我以往任何一次旅行都更让我满意。satisfy“使满意”，动词，根据前后句可知，本句是一般过去时，动词用过去式，故填satisfied。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: The woman introduced ___1___ (she) as Sarah.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：那个女人自我介绍叫莎拉。introduce oneself as“自我介绍叫”，she的反身代词herself，意为“她自己”。故填herself。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: She asked if Zhang could help look for her pen pal ___2___ was from China.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：她问张是否可以帮她寻找来自中国的笔友。根据“her pen pal ... was from China”可知此处是定语从句，先行词her pen pal指人，且在从句中作主语，用who引导定语从句。故填who。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: All the letters ___3___ (keep) by Sarah.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：所有的信都由莎拉保存着。主语“All the letters”与keep之间是动宾关系，陈述过去事实，用一般过去时的被动语态，主语是复数，be动词用were，keep的过去分词kept。故填were kept。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They were full ___4___ her sweet memories.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：它们充满了她甜蜜的回忆。be full of“充满”。故填of。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: It seemed impossible to find a person after such a long time, ___5___ Zhang promised to do his best.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：经过这么长时间，似乎不可能找到一个人，但张答应尽力而为。前后句意出现转折，用but表转折。故填but。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He posted some of Duan’s black-and-white ___6___ (photo) and their stories on the Internet.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：他在网上发布了段的一些黑白照片和他们的故事。根据“some of”可知此处用可数名词复数photos。故填photos。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: To his joy, many ___7___ (love) strangers joined him in searching for Duan.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：令他高兴的是，许多可爱的陌生人和他一起寻找段。根据“strangers”可知用love的形容词lovely表示“可爱的”，形容词作定语。故填lovely。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: A few months ___8___ (late), the two pen pals finally began to communicate with each other again.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：几个月后，这两个笔友终于又开始联系了。a few months later“几个月后”。故填later。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They were so excited that they decided ___9___ (meet) in China.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：她们非常兴奋，决定在中国见面。decide to do sth.“决定做某事”。故填to meet。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Sarah prepared a gift for Duan to celebrate her ___10___ (seventy-five) birthday.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：莎拉为段准备了一份礼物来庆祝她75岁的生日。根据“her ... birthday”可知用序数词表顺序，seventy-five的序数词seventy-fifth或75th。故填seventy-fifth/75th。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: It is on the ___1___ (five) day of lunar May every year.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：它在每年的农历五月初五。five“五”，基数词，此处表日期，应用其序数词fifth。故填fifth。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: There are many ___2___ (story) about the origin (起源) of this festival.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：关于这个节日的起源有很多故事。story“故事”，可数名词，被many修饰，用其复数形式。故填stories。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Among them, the following one about Qu Yuan is the most ___3___ (wide) accepted.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：其中，以下关于屈原的说法是最被广泛接受的。wide“宽的”，形容词，此处应用其副词widely“广泛地”，修饰动词accept。故填widely。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Qu Yuan was ___4___ great poet and good official.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：屈原是一位伟大的诗人和优秀的官员。此处泛指一位伟大的诗人，且great以辅音音素开头，其前应加不定冠词a。故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He ___5___ (jump) into Miluo River after his country’s being defeated.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：他的国家战败后，他跳进汨罗江。jump“跳”，动词。事情发生在过去，应为一般过去时，谓语动词用其过去式。故填jumped。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Now on the Dragon Boat Festival, Chinese people enjoy a one-day holiday ___6___ (remember) Qu Yuan.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：现在端午节，中国人享受一天的假期来纪念屈原。remember“记得”，动词。人们端午节放一天假的目的是为了纪念屈原，应用不定式表目的。故填to remember。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: People have different activities, including ___7___ (eat) zongzi and having dragon boat races and so on.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：人们有不同的活动，包括吃粽子和赛龙舟等等。eat“吃”，动词。including是介词，其后应用动名词作宾语。故填eating。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: The dragon boat races are the most ___8___ (excite) part of the festival.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：赛龙舟是这个节日中最令人兴奋的部分。excite“使兴奋”，动词。此处修饰龙舟赛，应用形容词exciting“令人兴奋的”作表语。故填exciting。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: All the teams practice so hard ___9___ they can become the winners.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：所有的球队都努力训练，他们可以成为胜利者。本句是句式so…that…，意为“如此……以至于……”。故填that。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Many western countries ___10___ (hold) dragon boat races every year, like Sweden, Canada and the USA．The Duanwu Festival is becoming more and more popular around the world.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：许多西方国家每年都举办龙舟赛，如瑞典、加拿大和美国。hold“举办”，动词。根据“every year”可知，本句是一般现在时，主语是复数，谓语动词用其原形。故填hold。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: 29th, 2022—China’s ___1___ (tradition) tea-making was added to the intangible cultural heritage list (非物质文化遗产名录) of the UNESCO.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：2022年11月29日—中国传统泡茶被列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录。此空修饰名词tea-making，应填形容词作定语，traditional“传统的”，故填traditional。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Tea has ___2___ history of more than 2000 years in China.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：茶在中国已有2000多年的历史。have a history of“有……的历史”，固定搭配，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: It ___3___ (say) that the Chinese character “cha” for tea is finally decided by Lu Yu.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：据说，汉字“茶”是鲁豫最后决定的。It is said that“据说”，固定句式，故填is said。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Since the Tang Dynasty (朝代), Chinese tea has left a big influence ___4___ other countries.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：自唐朝以来，中国茶就对其他国家产生了很大的影响。leave a big influence on/upon表示“对……产生了很大的影响”，固定搭配，故填on/upon。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Chinese tea was ___5___ (successful) introduced to many countries, such as India and Sri Lanka.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：中国茶被成功地介绍到许多国家，如印度和斯里兰卡。此空修饰动词introduced，应填副词successfully“成功地”，故填successfully。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Now a great number of people enjoy ___6___ (drink) tea.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：现在很多人喜欢喝茶。enjoy doing sth“喜欢做某事”，动名词作宾语，故填drinking。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Besides, they are greatly interested in ___7___ (it) history and culture.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：此外，他们对它的历史和文化很感兴趣。此空修饰名词history和culture，应填形容词性物主代词its，故填its。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: China is actually the only country ___8___ can produce all six types of tea—green, yellow, dark, white, oolong and black.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：中国实际上是唯一一个可以生产所有六种茶的国家——绿茶、黄茶、黑茶、白茶、乌龙茶和红茶。分析句子结构可知，此处是定语从句，先行词有the only修饰，关系词用that，故填that。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Chinese tea culture ___9___ (include) the Chinese way of dealing with the world.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：中国茶文化包含了中国对待世界的方式。此句是一般现在时，主语是不可数名词，动词用三单，故填includes。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: In tea, we find peace, art, and ___10___ (polite).
questions.analysis: 10．句意：在茶中，我们找到了平静、艺术和礼貌。此空与peace，art构成并列关系，作动词find的宾语，所以此空应填名词，故填politeness。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They often fight with each other for many ___1___ (reason).
questions.analysis: 1．句意：由于许多原因，他们经常互相打架。many后接复数名词，故填reasons。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: However, he doesn’t know ___2___ to do.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：但是，他不知道该怎么办。根据“Those fights influence his daily life. However, he doesn’t know...to do.”可知，他不知道该怎么办，此处是“疑问词+不定式”的结构，空处作do的宾语，应用what，故填what。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They always have smiles on ___3___ (they) faces.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：他们脸上总是挂着微笑。根据“They always have smiles on...faces.”可知，空处修饰其后的名词，应用形容词性物主代词，故填their。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Li Yong smiled and ___4___ (invite) Zhang Peng to his home.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：李勇微笑着邀请张鹏到家里做客。and连接的两部分形式要保持一致，结合“smiled”可知，此处的动词也用过去式，故填invited。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: As they entered the house, Li Yong’s elder brother saw them and said, “Hi, come and share some ice-cream ___5___ me.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：嗨，来和我一起吃冰淇淋。根据“come and share some ice-cream...me.”可知，此处是短语share sth with sb“和某人分享某物”，故填with。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” At the same time, Li Yong’s ___6___ (young) brother came out of his room.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：与此同时，李勇弟弟从他的房间里出来了。根据“He has two brothers”可知，此处指的是“弟弟”，英语表达为younger brother，故填younger。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: When he saw them, he looked very happy and said ___7___ (excited), “Hi, Li Yong, I have a story ___7___ (tell) you.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：当他看到他们时，他看起来很高兴，兴奋地说：“嗨，李勇，我有一个故事要告诉你。很有趣！”空处修饰动词，应用副词形式，故填excitedly。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: When he saw them, he looked very happy and said ___8___ (excited), “Hi, Li Yong, I have a story ___8___ (tell) you.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：我有一个故事要告诉你。空处作定语，应用不定式形式，故填to tell。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: After ___9___ (think) for a while, Zhang Peng understands that Li Yong’s secret of having ___9___ good relationship with his family is to share.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：想了想，张鹏明白了李咏和家人搞好关系的秘诀就是分享。after是介词，后接动名词doing形式，故填thinking。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: After ___10___ (think) for a while, Zhang Peng understands that Li Yong’s secret of having ___10___ good relationship with his family is to share.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：张鹏明白了李勇和家人搞好关系的秘诀就是分享。此处表示泛指“一段良好的关系”，应用不定冠词修饰，good是辅音音素开头的单词，应用a修饰，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: I and the other young horses ___1___ (eat) at the lower end of the field when we heard the cry of dogs far away.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：我和其他小马正在田野的尽头吃东西，突然听到远处传来狗的叫声。根据“when we heard the cry of dogs far away.”可知，此处是when引导的时间状语从句，从句是一般过去时，主句表示过去正在进行的动作，用过去进行时，主语是复数，be动词用were，故填were eating。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: The ___2___ (old) among us lifted his head to listen.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：我们当中年纪最大的那位抬起头来听。根据“among us”可知，三者以上的比较应用最高级，故填oldest。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: We followed him to the top ___3___ the field.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：我们跟着他来到了田顶。此处是固定搭配the top of“……的顶部”，故填of。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: “They have found a hare(野兔),” said my mother, “and if they come this way, we ___4___ (see) the hunt(打猎).
questions.analysis: 4．句意：如果他们从这边来，我们就能看到狩猎了。if引导的条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时，因为主语是第一人称we，我们可以使用“shall+动词原形”，故填shall see。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Suddenly, the dogs became ___5___ (silence) and ran around with their noses to the ground.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：突然，狗安静了下来，把鼻子贴在地上跑来跑去。became是系动词，后加形容词silent作表语，故填silent。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: “They ___6___ (lose) the smell of the hare already,” said the old horse.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：他们已经闻不到野兔的气味了。根据“already”可知，句子时态是现在完成时，主语是they，助动词用have，故填have lost。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Six or eight huntsmen(猎人) jumped their horses over ___7___ small river, close behind the dogs.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：六个或八个猎人跳上他们的马越过小河，紧跟在狗的后面。根据“jumped their horses over...small river,”可知，是指越过小河，应用定冠词the表示特指，故填the。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: She ___8___ (pick) up by one of the men.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：她被其中一个男人带走了。主语She代指兔子，和动词之间是被动关系，结合前句可知，应用一般过去时的被动语态，主语是单数，be动词用was，故填was picked。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: I was ___9___ surprised that at first I didn’t see what was happening by the river.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：我很惊讶，起初我没有看到河边发生了什么事。此处是“so...that...”结构，意为“如此……以至于……”，引导结果状语从句，故填so。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They quite often hurt ___10___ (they) and good horses.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：他们经常伤害自己和好马。句子主语是they，此处宾语和主语人称一致，应用反身代词themselves，故填themselves。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: In the UK, they have ___1___ interesting custom.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：在英国，他们有一个有趣的习俗。根据“interesting custom”可知，此处泛指一个有趣的习俗，interesting为元音音素开头的单词，用冠词an。故填an。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: According to the custom, the family will have good luck in the new year if a tall, dark and handsome man is the ___2___ (one) person to enter the front door after the new year arrives.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：根据习俗，如果一个高大、黝黑、英俊的男人是第一个新年到来后进入前门，这个家庭在新的一年里会有好运。根据“the…person”可知，此处指第一个人，one对应序数词first“第一个”。故填first。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Usually the ___3___ (visit) carries a piece of coal, a loaf (面包) and a bottle of Whiskey (威士忌酒).
questions.analysis: 3．句意：通常游客会带一块煤、一条面包和一瓶威士忌。根据“carries a piece of coal”和“He”可知，此处为名词，visitor“游客”，且为单数。故填visitor。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He should not speak to ___4___ (someone) or be spoken to until he finishes several things.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：在他做完几件事之前，不应该和任何人说话。根据“ He should not speak to …”可知，否定句用anyone，表示“任何人”。故填anyone。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: These things include placing the coal on the fire, putting the loaf on the table, ___5___ (serve) the drink to the family head and ___5___ (final) wishing everyone a “Happy New Year” .
questions.analysis: 5．句意：这些事情包括把煤放在火上，把面包放在桌子上，给户主端上饮料，最后祝大家“新年快乐”。根据“putting the loaf on the table”可知，空格处为动名词短语作主语。故填serving。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: These things include placing the coal on the fire, putting the loaf on the table, ___6___ (serve) the drink to the family head and ___6___ (final) wishing everyone a “Happy New Year” .
questions.analysis: 6．句意：这些事情包括把煤放在火上，把面包放在桌子上，给户主端上饮料，最后祝大家“新年快乐”。根据“wishing everyone a…”可知，此处为副词finally作时间状语。故finally。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They think that if there is still liquor in the house, there ___8___ (be) bad luck in the new year.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：他们认为，如果房子里还有酒，那么新的一年就会倒霉。根据“bad luck in the new year”可知，此处为一般将来时will+动词。故填will be。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: And in some ___9___ (area) in India, people do not celebrate the New Year, but cry.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：在印度的一些地区，人们不庆祝新年，而是哭泣。根据“some”可知，空格处为可数名词复数areas。故填areas。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: It is said that they cry ___10___ time goes quickly and life is so short.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：据说他们哭是因为时间过得很快，生命过得很短。根据“It is said that they cry … time goes quickly and life is so short.”可知，空格前后为前果后因，用because“因为”。故填because。

source.sourceSection: （2023·黑龙江牡丹江·统考中考真题）

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He was one of the most famous Chinese ___1___ （artist）of the 20th century.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：他是20世纪最著名的中国艺术家之一。one of the+形容词最高级+复数名词，表示“最……之一”。故填artists。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: At a young age, he ___2___ （encourage）by his family to paint.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：在他很小的时候，他的家人就鼓励他画画。根据“by his family”可知，此处用被动语态结构，主语he是第三人称单数形式，助动词用was，故填was encouraged。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: In 1917, he went to Japan ___3___ （learn）painting.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：1917年，他去日本学习绘画。去日本的目的是为了学习绘画，用动词不定式表目的，故填to learn。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Two years later, he went to Shanghai to receive ___4___ （tradition）painting instruction from two famous Chinese painters.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：两年后，他到上海接受两位中国著名画家的传统绘画指导。此空修饰名词painting，应填形容词traditional表示“传统的”，故填traditional。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Two years later, he went to Shanghai to receive 4 （tradition）painting instruction from two famous Chinese painters. ___5___
questions.analysis: 5．句意：在他们的帮助下，张有机会研究一些古代绘画。with the help of“在……的帮助下”，固定搭配，故填With。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He ___6___ （begin）to work with a Beijing painter, Pu Xinyu.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：他开始和北京画家溥心畬一起工作。整段用的都是一般过去时，所以此句也用一般过去时，动词用过去式，故填began。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Zhang and Pu were so well-known ___7___ they were honored as “South Zhang and North Pu”.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：张、溥是如此的知名，他们被誉为“南张北溥”。so…that“如此……以至于”，引导结果状语从句，故填that。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He and his group worked hard day and night there. ___8___
questions.analysis: 8．句意：最后，他们研究了200多幅画。此空位于句首，且空格后有逗号隔开，应填副词作状语，故填Finally。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: After this experience, his painting skills were much ___9___ （good）than before.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：这次经历后，他的绘画技巧比以前好多了。根据than可知，此空应填比较级，故填better。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: His painting, created in 1978, was sold at ___10___ very good price in 2021.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：1978年创作的这幅画在2021年以非常好的价格售出。at a good price“以一个非常好的价格”，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: The king promised to pay half of his gold ___1___ the water.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：国王答应用他一半的金子买水。根据“pay half of his gold ...the water.”可知，此处是短语pay...for...“为……支付……”，故填for。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: The news reached a farmer who had two ___2___ (son) and a daughter.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：这个消息传到了一个有两个儿子和一个女儿的农民那里。two后跟名词son的复数形式，故填sons。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They traveled a lot, ___3___ they still didn’t find it.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：他们跑了很多地方，但还是没找到。“They traveled a lot”和“ they still didn’t find it.”在句意上是转折关系，所以用but连接，故填but。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: So they brought some water from ___4___ river nearby.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：于是他们从附近的河里打了一些水来。根据“... river ”可知，此处泛指附近的一条河里，且river首字母发元音音素，所以用不定冠词a，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Of course, the prince got ___5___ (bad) than before.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：当然，王子的病情比以前更严重了。由than可知，此处用形容词bad的比较级worse。故填worse。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: She walked for a long time, and stopped ___6___ (have) a rest under a tree.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：她走了很长一段时间，然后在一棵树下停下来休息。根据“ stopped ... a rest under a tree”可知，是停下来去休息，stop to do sth“停下来做某事”，所以空处用动词不定式，故填to have。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Tina told ___7___ (they) the story.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：蒂娜给他们讲了这个故事。空处作told的宾语，所以用they的宾格them，故填them。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: “A long and ___8___ (danger) journey!
questions.analysis: 8．句意：漫长而危险的旅程！and连接两个并列成分，结合long可知，空处应用danger的形容词dangerous“危险的”，故填dangerous。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” Tina made a wish to get to the lake ___9___ (quick).
questions.analysis: 9．句意：蒂娜许愿要快点到湖边去。空处修饰动词get to，所以用quick的副词形式quickly“快速地”。故填quickly。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: The prince ___10___ (save).
questions.analysis: 10．句意：王子得救了。主语是动作save的承受者，所以用被动语态，全文是一般过去时，所以此处是一般过去时的被动语态，主语是The prince ，be动词用was，save的过去分词是saved，故填was saved。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: But his sons ___1___ (are) always fighting.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：但是他的儿子们总是争吵。根据上一句“Once upon a time, there was a wise old man who had seven sons.”可知，这是在讲述故事，句子应用一般过去时，主语his sons为复数名词，因此应用are的过去式were。故填were。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: It made some bad people happy because they wanted to cheat（欺骗）the brothers out of their ___2___ (father) money.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：这让一些坏人很高兴，因为他们想骗取兄弟们的父亲的钱。money为名词，此处应用father的名词所有格father’s来修饰名词money。故填father’s。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: One day, the father decided to help his sons stop ___3___ (fight), so he brought them together.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：有一天，父亲决定帮助他的儿子们停止战斗，于是他把他们召集在一起。根据“stop”可知此处应用动词短语stop doing sth表示“停止做某事”，动词fight的动名词为fighting。故填fighting。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He tied seven chopsticks together, and said, “I will give all of my money to ___4___ one who can break this bundle（捆）.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：我会把我所有的钱都给那个能折断这捆筷子的人。根据“one who”可知who引导限制性定语从句，修饰代词one，因此其前应用定冠词the来表特指。故填the。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” The seven sons each tried ___5___ (break) the chopsticks, but it was too hard.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：七个儿子都努力去折断筷子，但是太难了。根据“tried”可知此处应用动词短语try to do sth表示“努力做某事”，动词break的不定式为to break。故填to break。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” He untied the chopsticks and broke them one ___6___ one easily.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：他解开筷子，轻而易举地把它们一根一根地折断。根据“one…one”可知此处应用one by one来表示“一个接一个地”。故填by。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” The father ___7___ (go) on, “As it is with these chopsticks, so it is with you, my sons.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：父亲继续说道：“我的儿子们，正如这些筷子一样，你们也是如此。如果你们团结一致，互相帮助，你们会做得很好，没有人可以伤害你们。但如果你们打架，你们会像这双筷子一样，又碎又弱。”结合语境，句子应用一般过去时，动词go的过去式为went。故填went。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: But if you fight, you will be like these chopsticks, broken ___8___ weak.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：父亲继续说道：“我的儿子们，正如这些筷子一样，你们也是如此。如果你们团结一致，互相帮助，你们会做得很好，没有人可以伤害你们。但如果你们打架，你们会像这双筷子一样，又碎又弱。”根据“broken”和“weak”可知此处应用表示并列关系的连词and来连接两个形容词。故填and。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ” The seven sons listened ___9___ (careful) and promised to stick together.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：七个儿子认真地听着，并保证会团结一致。listened为动词，此处应用careful的副词carefully来修饰动词。故填carefully。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They kept their promise and faced life’s ___10___ (difficulty) together, just as their wise father had taught them.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：他们信守诺言，共同面对生活中的困难，正如他们睿智的父亲教导他们的那样。根据“faced life’s”可知此处应用名词difficult的复数形式difficulties来表示“面对生活中的困难”。故填difficulties。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: But foxes can live in all kinds of amazingly different ___1___ (place) such as deserts, mountain s and cities.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：但是狐狸可以生活在各种不同的地方，比如沙漠、山区和城市。different修饰可数名词法术，所以空处用place的复数形式places，故填places。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: A city like London can be really busy and ___2___ (noise), but it still has quiet corners where foxes can sleep.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：像伦敦这样的城市可能非常繁忙和嘈杂，但它仍然有安静的角落，狐狸可以在那里睡觉。根据“can be really busy and....”可知，空处应填形容词作表语，noise的形容词是noisy“嘈杂的”。故填noisy。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Recently some people in cities have already ___3___ (see) foxes close at hand, but they never seem scared.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：最近，城市里的一些人已经看到狐狸近在咫尺，但他们似乎从不害怕。根据“have already”可知，此处用see的过去分词seen构成现在完成时结构，故填seen。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They are ___4___ smart that they can even remember all the safe corners where they can escape.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：它们非常聪明，甚至能记住所有可以逃跑的安全角落。根据“...smart that they can even remember all the safe corners where they can escape. ”可知，此处是so...that...“如此……以至于……”引导的条件状语从句，故填so。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: If a fox thinks it can run to its safe exit ___5___ (fast) than you can approach (接近), it will probably just sit down and wait.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：如果一只狐狸认为它跑到安全出口的速度比你接近的速度快，它可能会坐下来等着。根据than可知，此处用fast的比较级faster，故填faster。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They won’t waste energy running off unless it really ___6___ (become) necessary.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：除非真的有必要，否则他们不会浪费能量跑掉。本句是unless引导的条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时，则从句用一般现在时，主语是it，谓语动词用三单形式，故填becomes。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: However, it’s ___7___ (usual) better not to feed foxes.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：然而，通常最好不要喂狐狸。分析句子可知，句中不缺成分，所以空处应用usual的副词形式usually“通常地”作状语，故填usually。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: But do enjoy ___8___ (watch ) them.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：但是一定要喜欢观察它们。enjoy doing sth“喜欢做某事”，所以空处用动名词作宾语，故填watching。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They are beautiful interesting animals and lots ___9___ people enjoy them around.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：它们是美丽有趣的动物，很多人喜欢它们。lots of“很多”，固定短语，故填of。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: After all, seeing foxes is ___10___ exciting reminder of our connection to nature.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：毕竟，看到狐狸是一个令人兴奋的提醒，提醒我们与自然的联系。根据单数名词reminder可知，此处表示泛指，且exciting是以元音音素开头，所以用不定冠词an修饰，故填an。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: | In February, there was a video about Asian elephants in Yunnan, in which two ___1___ (elephant) were fighting for food.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：今年2月，有一个关于云南亚洲象的视频，两头大象在争夺食物。two修饰可数名词复数，故填elephants。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: By ___2___ end of 2022, the number of wild Asian elephants ___2___ (be) more than 300.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：到2022年底，野生亚洲象的数量超过了300头。by the end of...“到……为止”，故填the。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: By ___3___ end of 2022, the number of wild Asian elephants ___3___ (be) more than 300.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：到2022年底，野生亚洲象的数量超过了300头。本句主语中心词是“the number of”，强调整体数量，时态是一般过去时，故填was。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: They started to visit villages. ___4___
questions.analysis: 4．句意：他们为什么这样做呢？根据“Because they needed more space and food.”可知，此处在回答原因，用Why提问，故填Why。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Sometimes, the elephants were scared and ___5___ (hurt) people.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：有时，大象会受到惊吓，伤害人类。根据“were”可知，时态是一般过去时，动词用过去式，hurt的过去式还是hurt。故填hurt。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: So the local government is ___6___ (think) of some smart ways to get along with the cute but naughty animals.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：因此，当地政府正在考虑一些聪明的方法来与这些可爱但淘气的动物相处。根据“So the local government is...of some smart ways to get along with the cute but naughty animals.”可知，动作正在发生，时态是现在进行时，动词用现在分词形式，故填thinking。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ◆ If you see some elephants, stay ___7___ least 300 meters away from them.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：如果你看到一些大象，要离它们至少300米远。根据“If you see some elephants, stay...least 300 meters away from them.”可知，此处是at least短语，意为“至少”，故填at。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Also, you should leave the place ___8___ (quick).
questions.analysis: 8．句意：还有，你应该尽快离开这个地方。此处在句中修饰动词，用副词形式，故填quickly。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: ◆ If you are in a place with elephants, don’t ___9___ (wear) bright-colored clothes.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：如果你在有大象的地方，不要穿颜色鲜艳的衣服。助动词don’t后用动词原形，故填wear。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: Such clothes could make elephants ___10___ (angry).
questions.analysis: 10．句意：这样的衣服会让大象生气。make...+adj“使……”，故填angry。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: I left it on the bus on the way back to ___1___ (we) school.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：我把它落在回学校的公交车上了。此处作定语修饰“school”，所以用形容词性物主代词，故填our。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: I called the bus company the next day ___2___ (check) if they could find it, but it wasn’t there.
questions.analysis: 2．句意：第二天，我打电话给公共汽车公司，问他们是否能找到它，但它不在那里。此处在句中表示目的，用动词不定式形式，故填to check。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: I ___3___ (know) they were right, so I decided I would get one by myself.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：我知道他们是对的，所以我决定自己买一个。本句时态是一般过去时，所以动词用过去式。故填knew。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: My parents ___4___ (usual) give me £8 every week, so the first thing I did was to keep the money ___4___ the small box on the bookcase.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：我的父母通常每周给我8英镑，所以我做的第一件事就是把钱放在书架上的小盒子里。此处在句中修饰动词，用副词usually，故填usually。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: My parents ___5___ (usual) give me £8 every week, so the first thing I did was to keep the money ___5___ the small box on the bookcase.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：我的父母通常每周给我8英镑，所以我做的第一件事就是把钱放在书架上的小盒子里。in the box“在盒子里”，故填in。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: He’s often away for work, but he can’t ___6___ (take) his dog with him.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：他经常出差，但他不能带着他的狗。情态动词“can’t”后用动词原形，故填take。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: So, I started working for three ___7___ (family) living across the street.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：于是，我开始为住在街对面的三户人家打工。three修饰可数名词复数，故填families。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: It was the same as the one I had lost, but to me it was much ___8___ (nice).
questions.analysis: 8．句意：它和我失去的那个一模一样，但对我来说要好得多。much修饰比较级，强调比较含义，故填nicer。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: I paid for it with ___9___ money I made and it felt very different.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：我用自己赚的钱买了它，感觉很不一样。此处特指自己赚的钱，故填the。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: This experience teaches me what it means to work hard and I ___10___ (learn) that you must be careful with the things you have, because they take a lot of hard work.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：这段经历教会了我努力工作的意义，我学会了你必须小心对待你拥有的东西，因为它们需要付出很多努力。根据“This experience teaches me what it means to work hard and I...that you must be careful with the things you have”可知，本句可用现在完成时强调动作已经发生，或用一般现在时强调现在，主语是I，助动词是have，动词用原形。故填have learned/have learnt/learn。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：专题6.语法填空解题技巧

questions.prompt: The ___1___ (reason) for these things are told in a beautiful story about a brave young man, Heng Jing.
questions.analysis: 1．句意：这些事情的原因都在一个美丽的故事中讲述了一个勇敢的年轻人，恒景。根据“are”可知，主语需要复数，故填reasons。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: About 2000 years ago, in the River Ru there lived ___2___ devil (魔鬼).
questions.analysis: 2．句意：大约两千年前，汝河里住着一个魔鬼。根据“devil”可知，需要一个冠词表示泛指，devil是辅音音素开头，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: He went deep into the mountains to study kung fu and made ___3___ (he) strong.
questions.analysis: 3．句意：他深入深山学习功夫，使自己变得强壮。根据“made”可知，此处是指让他自己强壮，用反身代词，故填himself。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: He ___4___ (lead) the people from his village up a mountain.
questions.analysis: 4．句意：他带领村民上山。根据“he went back”可知，句子时态是一般过去时，lead的过去式是led，故填led。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: He asked them ___5___ (carry) zhuyu and drink some chrysanthemum wine.
questions.analysis: 5．句意：他让他们拿着茱萸，喝点菊花酒。ask sb to do sth“要求某人做某事”，此处用动词不定式，故填to carry。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It’s believed that zhuyu would make the devil scared ___6___ the wine would protect them from illnesses.
questions.analysis: 6．句意：据信，茱萸可以使魔鬼害怕，酒可以保护他们免受疾病。 根据“zhuyu would make the devil scared ”和“the wine would protect them from illnesses”可知，两者是并列关系，故填and。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: And ___7___ (final), Heng Jing killed the devil.
questions.analysis: 7．句意：最后，恒景杀了恶魔。根据“Heng Jing killed the devil”可知，副词修饰整个句子，finally符合句意，故填finally。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: The whole village celebrated, because they ___8___ (save) by the brave young man.
questions.analysis: 8．句意：全村的人都在庆祝，因为他们被那个勇敢的年轻人救了。根据“by”和“The whole village celebrated”可知，句子时态是一般过去时，且是被动语态，主语是复数，be动词用were，故填were saved。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: It’s a day to show respect for elderly people and wish them a much ___9___ (long) and healthier life.
questions.analysis: 9．句意：这是一个向老年人表示尊重并祝愿他们健康长寿的日子。根据“ much ”可知，此处需要比较级，longer符合句意，故填longer。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Respecting elderly people can be shown not only ___10___ this special day but also in daily life.
questions.analysis: 10．句意：尊重老人不仅可以在这个特殊的日子里表现出来，也可以在日常生活中表现出来。根据“this special day”可知，具体的一天前用介词on，故填on。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Books play an ___11___ (importance) role in our life.
questions.analysis: 11．句意：书籍在我们生活中起着重要的作用。importance“重要性”，是名词，修饰名词role，用形容词，故填important。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: This book was ___12___ (write) by Daniel Defue.
questions.analysis: 12．句意：这本书是丹尼尔·笛福写的。write“写”，主语this book与谓语write之间是被动关系，因此用被动语态，故填written。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: And so far, it ___13___ ( influence) many students like me.
questions.analysis: 13．句意：迄今为止，它影响力像我一样的很多学生。influence“影响”，根据“so far”可知，此处用现在完成时，主语it是第三人称单数形式，谓语用第三人称单数形式，故填has influenced。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: I like him so ___14___ ( more).
questions.analysis: 14．句意：我非常喜欢它。more“更多的”，是many或much的比较级，so much“如此多”，故填much。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When Robinson was young, he ___15___ (dream) of sailing on the sea day and night.
questions.analysis: 15．句意：当鲁滨逊小的时候，他梦想着日夜在海上航行。dream“梦想”，根据“When Robinson was young”知，此处用一般过去时，故填dreamed/dreamt。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: When Robinson was young, he 15 (dream) of sailing on the sea day and night. ___16___
questions.analysis: 16．句意：不幸的是，他长大后，他在一个无人居住的小岛上生活了28年。unlucky“不幸的”，是形容词，此处修饰整个句子，用副词，故填Unluckily。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: During ___17___ (that) years, he had to experience hunger and fight against natural disasters (灾害).
questions.analysis: 17．句意：在那些年里，他必须经历了饥饿和与自然灾害作斗争。that“那个”，其复数形式是those，修饰复数名词years，用those，故填those。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Finally, the great man succeeded in ___18___ (deal) with a lot of difficulties and went out of the island because of his fighting spirit and hard work.
questions.analysis: 18．句意：最后，由于他的战斗精神和努力工作，这位伟人成功地克服了许多困难，走出了孤岛。deal“应对”，succeed in doing sth“成功地做某事”，故填dealing。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Just as the ___19___ (say) goes, “ No pains, no gains.
questions.analysis: 19．句意：俗话说：“一分耕耘，一分收获。”say“说”，其名词是saying“谚语”，有定冠词the修饰，用名词，故填saying。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: ” And only hard work can lead ___20___ (we) to a better life.
questions.analysis: 20．句意：只有努力工作才能使我们过上更好的生活。we“我们”，是主格形式，其宾格形式是us，作为动词lead的宾语，用宾格形式，故填us。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Major General Jing Haipeng, one of the first generation of Chinese astronauts, is the first Chinese person ___21___ （return）to space and travel three ___21___ （time）into orbit.
questions.analysis: 21．句意：景海鹏少将是中国第一代宇航员之一，是第一位返回太空并三次进入轨道的中国人。the first person to do“第一个做……的人”，固定搭配，所以此空应填return“返回”的不定式形式，故填to return。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Major General Jing Haipeng, one of the first generation of Chinese astronauts, is the first Chinese person ___22___ （return）to space and travel three ___22___ （time）into orbit.
questions.analysis: 22．句意：景海鹏少将是中国第一代宇航员之一，是第一位返回太空并三次进入轨道的中国人。根据“...travel three...into orbit.”可知，此处表示three times“三次”，故填times。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: So far, he ___23___ （be）a crew commander for the third time.
questions.analysis: 23．句意：到目前为止，他已经是第三次担任机组指挥官了。根据“So far”可知，本句为现在完成时，其构成为have/has+done，又因为主语he为第三人称单数，所以谓语动词用三单，故填has been。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Jing studied very hard at school in the hope of ___24___ （go）to university to get the family out of poverty and make his parents happy.
questions.analysis: 24．句意：景在学校学习很努力，希望能上大学，让家里摆脱贫困，让父母幸福。因为空前有介词of，所以此空应填go“去”的动名词形式，故填going。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: So he never ___25___ （buy）a single meal at middle school and lived on dry food and salted vegetables he brought from home.
questions.analysis: 25．句意：因此，他在中学时从未买过一顿饭，靠从家里带来的干粮和咸菜生活。and连接并列成分，结合动词lived可知，此空应填buy的过去式，故填bought。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: “The hard life had not only given me the courage to face so many ___26___ （difficulty）and challenges, but also inspired（鼓舞）me to chase my dream.
questions.analysis: 26．句意：艰苦的生活不仅让我有勇气面对如此多的困难和挑战，也激励我追逐梦想。many后加可数名词复数形式，所以此空应填difficulty“困难”的复数形式，故填difficulties。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Three months ___27___ （late）, he went to an Air Force flight college in Baoding, Hebei province.
questions.analysis: 27．句意：三个月后，他去了河北保定的一所空军飞行学院。根据“Three months..., he went to an Air Force flight college in Baoding, Hebei province.”可知，此处表示三个月后，three months later“三个月后”，故填later。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: “I always told ___28___ （I）that top pilots only come from those who train hardest.
questions.analysis: 28．句意：我一直告诉自己，顶尖的飞行员只来自那些训练最刻苦的人。根据“I always told...that top pilots only come from those who train hardest.”可知，此处表示景海鹏告诫自己，所以此空应填I的反身代词形式myself，故填myself。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In the years in the fighter jet unit, he ___29___ （consider）as an excellent pilot.
questions.analysis: 29．句意：在战斗机部队的几年里，他被认为是一名优秀的飞行员。he与consider为被动关系，其构成为：be+done，又因为“In the years in the fighter jet unit”可知，本句为一般过去时，主语he为第三人称单数，be用was，故填was considered。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: In the summer of 1996, Jing was told ___30___ （experience）physical exams by his leader without knowing the reason.
questions.analysis: 30．句意：1996年夏天，景在不知道原因的情况下，被领导叫去参加体检。be told to do“被告知去做某事”，固定搭配，所以此空填experience“经历”的不定式形式，故填to experience。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: I’m a Russian farmer and just know some ___31___ (expression) in English.
questions.analysis: 31．句意：我是一个俄罗斯农民，只知道一些英语表达。some修饰可数名词的复数，expression意为“表达方式”，是可数名词，复数是expressions，故填expressions。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: I know just enough to ask for help ___32___ (polite) when I get into trouble.
questions.analysis: 32．句意：当我遇到麻烦时，我只知道礼貌地请求帮助。ask为实义动词，用副词修饰，polite意为“礼貌的”，是形容词，其副词形式为politely，故填politely。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: Last month I went to UK and had ___33___ (冠词) good time.
questions.analysis: 33．句意：上个月我去了英国，玩得很开心。have a good time意为“玩得开心”，是动词短语，故填a。

leadBlocks.text: 来源：第08讲 语法填空（讲义）-2024年中考英语一轮复习讲练测（全国通用）

questions.prompt: I got up early in the morning and asked a hotel clerk where I could ___34___ (have) breakfast.
